title: Cone Calculator
description: From radius and height get cone volume, slant height, lateral and total surface area.
howto: Type the radius and the vertical height.
Read the slant height, volume and surface areas with the working.

faqs.a: The distance from the tip to the base edge along the side: l = √(r² + h²) by Pythagoras.

faqs.q: Why is the volume divided by 3?
faqs.a: A cone holds exactly one-third of the cylinder with the same base and height.
Height is vertical (tip to base center); slant height runs along the slanted side. Use height for volume.
